title: Empire Goes Mental…and Other Head Games
author: Steve Kelly
content:
![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/mike-newbry-
lYH1V5Z1Wf8-unsplash-680x453.jpg)

Image by Mike Newbry.

Nature is under siege. America’s debt slaves are paying for it. I know, duh!

Across Montana and the mountainous territories of the Northern Rockies
ecosystem the Trump administration’s psychotic ‘flood-the-zone,’ scorched
earth strategy is in full swing. Violent mechanical attacks target wilderness,
critical wildlife habitat, remnant fragments of old growth forest, clean air,
and clean water – liquidation and industrial-strength destruction,
simultaneously.

Congress, most federal judges, and the Trump administration shamelessly
subsidize habitat loss and species extinction.

Now in full-tantrum mode, Washington politicians and their brain-dead agency
bootlickers (“just following orders”) have turned “regular congressional
order” into Zio-Pseudo-Christian suck up sessions. Billionaire interlopers
want to domesticate and convert millions of public wildlands into playgrounds.

These sick paternalistic nobodies use money and power to grab territory,
destroy Mother Nature and all representations of the sacred feminine. It’s all
very Old Testament redux.

**“Flood the Zone” Political Strategy**

Overloading the zone is the current preferred political strategy driving
everyone crazy. Its objective is to create chaos, confusion and exhaustion in
the media and cultural institutions. Information broadcast from a high-volume
firehose, especially controversial executive orders and unprecedented supreme
court decisions presented in a TV reality show format, kills honest debate by
wearing down media newsrooms and overwhelming audiences until the
psychological noise and its associated cognitive dissonance is normalized.
It’s all part of the oligarchic plan behind fragmenting and annihilating any
possibility of joining/rejoining that which is never meant to be apart. These
are the twisted masterminds/puppeteers, funding, producing and directing
Trump’s hyperreality show.

Information overload is designed to combine neoliberal (“supply-side”)
economics with Zio-Pseudo-Christian literalist doctrine, presented ad nauseam
in rapid-fire _Trumpisms_ (extemporaneous cartoon dramas). When aggregated and
force-fed to consumers, information overload conditions us to unlearn our
natural ability to discern by robbing us of our instinctive ability to feel.
It is important to understand how flooding the zone feeds multiple oligarchic
worldwide aims: 1) human sacrifice/depopulation, 2) extending social control,
3) maximizing deterrence, and 4) global domination over individuals and
nations. Mass neurosis is exhausting, it overwhelms and neutralizes much of
the opposition.

_In reality, it is indifference that rules over the kingdom of difference;
there is no longer any_ _concern here with distinguishing between true or
false or between liberty and irresponsibility. This is a tangible
indifference. - _Annie le Brun, Reality Overload, p. 195. (2000).

**Contemporary Innovations of Capitalism**

Empire’s power grab for territory is seen clearly in the forced starvation and
genocide in Gaza, as in perpetual war, as in the slaughter of wild Yellowstone
buffalo entering Montana for a bite to eat, and as in native forests being
“treated” (bulldozed, clearcut, torched by government arsonists, and
masticated to feed more cows). This territorial power grab has now migrated
into the sensory cultural realm, increasing human insensitivity, and degrading
our relationships with other living beings and our natural environment.

All relationships are threatened by secular techno-geeks and religious
fanatics – _God’s chosen people_ – determined to replace natural
interdependencies with their calamitous belief in fictitious materialism.
History and critical meaning are diluted altered, and gradually erased, as
powerful commercial forces subvert and replace the imaginary, the creative,
and the natural rhythms of the magical with the mechanical and virtual. Models
and virtual realities eat away at our memory, robbing us of the dream that
once illuminated solitude and spaces that transcend beyond our known horizons.
Technology keeps arresting human potential by pushing aside dreams with
machine-made virtual hyperreality.

**Imagine and Prepare the Transition Toward a New Era**

_“Oh my brothers, am I perhaps cruel? But I say: if something is falling, one
should also give it a push! Everything of today – it is falling, it is
failing: who would want to stop it! But I–I want to push it too!”_** -**
Friedrich Nietzsche, [Thus Spake
Zarathustra](https://www.goodreads.com/work/quotes/196327)

A strong and growing grassroots resistance movement is fighting against
privatization of public lands, weaker environmental laws, and the spiraling
downward trends toward mass extinctions and meaningless (sometimes zero)
public participation.

The system’s theft of our imagination threatens the fundamental ground of our
continued existence. How will we overcome this piracy, these psychotic
pirates?

It is time for all passionate freethinkers to emerge as individuals and small
groups, stand up for voiceless animals and plants. Be counted and think deeply
about co-creating the transition leading to the next era. What will it be? How
will we get there? How will we transcend the intractable problem of anxiety
over meaninglessness and our own finitude?

Dreams inspire our most creative thoughts. We must repossess our deepest
connections to qualitative time (Kairos), our physical world, and to all other
lifeforms. Something magical, ineffable, is waiting to be rediscovered in
Nature. Beyond mindless consumption and conformity, this something is in us,
not _out there._

Lesson #1: Nature’s laws have been trying to teach us that man is hardly the
entirety of all infinite space and time. Man is not God and thus not the
Creator of himself or of his Natural Environment (Source).

We must find the courage to gather and reassemble the wonderful analogical
moments (fragments) that spark individual passion for the poetic and artistic
and restore our individual life, our sensory life.

Think on it, dream on it, accept the invitation to co-create the future where
we all can ultimately reconnect as an integral part of being-itself. Dream
Big!
